Train a custom random forest with consensus label cleaning

Source: R/model_training.R
train_custom_randomforest.Rd

Train a ranger random forest classifier on labelled cells from a SpatialExperiment or SingleCellExperiment. The workflow has two stages:

  1. Consensus cleaning: repeated stratified cross-validation is used to estimate how consistently each labelled cell is predicted as its original label. Cells with agreement below agreement_thresh are flagged as unreliable and relabeled as unknown_label in colData(spe)$cleaned_core_label.

  2. Model evaluation and final training: cross-validation is run on the cleaned labelled set to report accuracy and macro-F1, and a final probability random forest model is trained on all cleaned labelled cells.

Usage

train_custom_randomforest(
  spe,
  label_col = "cutoff_label",
  assay_name = "exprs",
  unknown_label = "Unknown",
  num.trees = 200,
  mtry = NULL,
  seed = NULL,
  features = "all",
  cv_folds = 5,
  repeats = 10,
  agreement_thresh = 0.8,
  num_threads = 2
)

Arguments

spe

A SpatialExperiment or SingleCellExperiment.

label_col

Character scalar naming the label column in colData(spe) (default "cutoff_label").

assay_name

Character scalar naming the assay used as features (default "exprs").

unknown_label

Character label treated as unlabeled and excluded from training/cleaning (default "Unknown").

num.trees

Integer number of trees for the final ranger model (default 200).

mtry

Optional integer mtry for ranger. If NULL, uses floor(sqrt(p)) where p is the number of features used.

seed

Optional integer seed for reproducibility.

features

Character vector of feature (marker) names to use, or "all" to use all assay rows (default "all").

cv_folds

Integer number of folds used for stratified cross-validation (default 5).

repeats

Integer number of repeated CV rounds used during consensus cleaning (default 10).

agreement_thresh

Numeric in [0,1] specifying the minimum agreement rate required to keep an originally labelled cell during cleaning (default 0.8).

num_threads

Integer requested number of threads for model fitting.

Value

A named list with components:

spe

The input spe with an added colData column cleaned_core_label, where low-agreement labelled cells are set to unknown_label.

model

A fitted ranger model trained on the cleaned labelled cells with probability = TRUE.

agreement_rates

Named numeric vector of per-cell agreement rates from the consensus cleaning stage (indexed by training-row names).

features_used

Character vector of feature names used for training.

metrics

List of evaluation outputs on the cleaned labelled set:

confusion_matrix

Confusion matrix for pooled CV predictions.

accuracy

Overall pooled CV accuracy.

f1_macro

Overall pooled macro-F1.

cv_overall

Per-fold data.frame with accuracy and macro-F1.

cv_class_metrics

Per-fold, per-class precision/recall/F1 table.

test_pred

Factor of pooled cross-validated predictions on cleaned labelled cells.

test_truth

Factor of pooled cross-validated true labels on cleaned labelled cells.

Details

During consensus cleaning, models are trained without probability estimation. The final model is trained with probability = TRUE to support downstream thresholding workflows.

Examples

# \donttest{
data("cytoGateR_example", package = "cytoGateR")
image_ids <- SummarizedExperiment::colData(cytoGateR_example)$image_name
spe <- cytoGateR_example[, image_ids == image_ids[1L]]
fit <- train_custom_randomforest(
  spe,
  label_col = "core_group",
  unknown_label = "Unassigned",
  features = c("CD3e", "CD20", "CD4", "CD8a"),
  num.trees = 25,
  cv_folds = 2,
  repeats = 1,
  agreement_thresh = 0,
  num_threads = 1,
  seed = 1
)
#> Processing 1378 core cells via 1 repeated CV folds...
#> Training final model on 1378 cleaned cells...
fit$model
#> Ranger result
#> 
#> Call:
#>  ranger::ranger(original_label ~ ., data = cleaned_df, num.trees = num.trees,      mtry = mtry_val, probability = TRUE, num.threads = num_threads) 
#> 
#> Type:                             Probability estimation 
#> Number of trees:                  25 
#> Sample size:                      1378 
#> Number of independent variables:  4 
#> Mtry:                             2 
#> Target node size:                 10 
#> Variable importance mode:         none 
#> Splitrule:                        gini 
#> OOB prediction error (Brier s.):  0.1906214 
# }
